snippet.title: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift | Demo Teaser
snippet.description:
Point & Click Fantasy Thriller: A burst of light - a crystal devours your little brother's life force. Desperate to save him, you must uncover the truth behind magic, while a dread mage closes in to tear the crystal from your hands - and with it, all hope.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4373410/Two_Realms_Whispers_from_the_Rift_Demo/
About: https://mod42.cz
Press: https://mod42.cz/presskit

Story / Direction / SFX: Jaromír Janisch
Graphics / Art / Animations: Tomáš Létal
Music: Martin Srpek Konvička
Tobias' voice: Daniel Berry
